_about: What each designed site looks like, for scripts/check-fingerprints.mjs (Tzvi, 19 Oct 2026: businesses must not come out too similar). Fonts and colours are read from the pages; these six are written by hand when a site is built. own_colours: colours taken from the business's own logo or menu, which never count as a clash. effects: one id per kind from _effects (rules 3p.4); shared effects between two sites may total 2 points, a loud one counting 2. A pinned or scrubbed scene is a technique, not an effect: what it shows is the signature.
